metadata.methodology: Sequential line-window reads of core page files via Bob transcription API

AdminShell.tsx.purpose: Admin / Master / Grand Master portal shell with consolidated navigation

architecture.navigation_consolidation: Sidebar reduced from ~57 items to ≤15 top-level items
container_pages: CRMFinancePage (tabs: invoicing, payments, generate-invoice, oncall, financial-setup, rate-rules, tenders)
RosterHRPage (tabs: staff, training, assets, disciplinary, credential-expiry, shift-templates, leave-approval, timesheets, callouts)
FieldOperationsPage (sub-areas: dispatch, patrol, live-map, welfare-alerts, breach-review, vehicle-search, field-reports, parking, noise-control, biosecurity, smoke-control)
ReportsPage (tabs: reports-hub, report-packs, obligations, fc-reporting, fc-compliance, fc-command-results)
architecture.url_compatibility: Legacy URLs redirect to new parent pages with tab/sub-area pre-selected
architecture.module_gating: Applied at tab/card level within container pages, not just parent level
architecture.bob_context: Each tab/sub-area provides specific BobContext for portal awareness

type_definitions.AdminPage: hub | crm | roster | field-ops | reports | sites | site-360 | site-ownership | locations | users | access-control | org-setup | approvals | testing | test-data | platform | platform-catalog | platform-subscriptions | platform-billing

state_management.activePage: Current page key from URL, derived via pageFromUrl()
state_management.crmTab: Active tab in CRM & Finance container (default: 'crm')
state_management.rosterTab: Active tab in Roster & HR container (default: 'roster')
state_management.enabledModules: Set of enabled module keys for the org (null = unconfigured, fail-open)

key_functions.pageFromUrl: Derive AdminPage from URL pathname; handle legacy redirects
key_functions.navigateToPage: Navigate to admin page: push URL + set state + update sub-page state
key_functions.isPageEnabled: Check if page is accessible based on user role and enabled modules
key_functions.renderPage: Render the current page component with appropriate props
key_functions.getBobContext: Derive Bob context from active page + sub-page state
key_functions.handleSearchNavigate: Route universal search results to correct page/sub-area
key_functions.handleConfigureSiteZones: Handle site zone configuration from CRM page

module_gating.PAGE_REQUIRED_MODULE: No top-level pages require modules in Phase 1; gating at tab/card level within container pages
module_gating.isPageEnabled_logic: If isPlatformOperator (grand_master/master) return true; else check if required module in enabledModules

on_mount: Load enabledModules from organization_modules table (fail-open if error/empty)
Sync sub-page state if legacy redirect
on_page_change: If not enabled, render AdminHubPage as fallback
Else render page with props: initialTab/initialSubArea, onTabChange, enabledModules, isPlatformOperator
render_flow.lazy_loading: Container pages use React.lazy() with Suspense boundaries inside <main data-app-content>
render_flow.code_splitting: Epic #203, R7 #210 — route-level code-splitting; shell layout/sidebar/top bar remain rendered while chunks load

components.NavItem: Reusable nav item button with active state, icon, label, collapse support
components.UniversalSearch: Global search bar that routes results to vehicle-search, breach-review, locations, crm
components.NotificationsBell: Approvals + Bob reach-out notifications; opens BobPanel on conversation
components.PortalSwitcher: For admin_officer: switch between /admin and /officer without logout
components.BobPanel: AI assistant panel with context-aware prompting

desktop_layout.sidebar: 220px default, 68px collapsed; nav groups with lazy load
desktop_layout.top_bar: Org name, NotificationsBell, role chip, user display name
desktop_layout.main_content: Flex 1, render page with data-app-content attribute

mobile_layout.top_bar: Logo, org name, PortalSwitcher, NotificationsBell, menu button
mobile_layout.bottom_tab_bar: 5 quick-access tabs (Home, Field Ops, Roster, CRM, Reports) + Bob button
mobile_layout.pages: Flex 1 main content area with data-app-content

supabase_integration.error_handling: Fail-open pattern: if read error or no rows, leave enabledModules null (all pages visible)

OfficerShell.tsx.purpose: Field officer portal shell with four entry states and persistent safety chrome

four_states.WELFARE_STANDBY: No shift, no direct access; SOS/welfare check-in always available
four_states.MODULE_SELECTOR: Admin granted multiple direct modules (standalone access)

four_state_machine.standby: StandbyScreen: no shift, refresh every 30s, quick-access buttons
four_state_machine.home: OfficerHome: active shift display, offered shift cards, module selection, navigation
four_state_machine.selector: ModuleSelector: grid of granted modules for standalone access
four_state_machine.portal: ModulePortal: breadcrumb back, module header, content, Report FAB

architecture.welfare_integration: useWelfareCheckin hook with check-in cadence (default 30 min), man-down detection via GPS inactivity
architecture.module_gating: Officer sees module only if both: profile.moduleAccess includes it AND org has module enabled

type_definitions.ActiveModule: freedom_camping | parking | noise_control | biosecurity | smoke_control | site_guard | ems | patrol | report | leave | timesheet | schedule | overnight_verification | checkpoint_scan | map | dispatch | debrief | vehicle_lookup | credentials | modules | null

state_management.activeModule: Current module from URL or null (home)
state_management.shiftState: useActiveShift hook result: { active, upcoming, refresh }
state_management.moduleAccess: Filtered grantedModules based on org enabledModules
state_management.gps: Latest GPS fix { lat, lng } or null
state_management.offeredCount: Number of offered shifts pending officer response
state_management.welfareStatus: From useWelfareCheckin: ok | due | overdue | man_down | sos

key_functions.navigateToModule: Navigate to officer module: push URL + set state
key_functions.canonicalModuleKey: Map officer module names to canonical org module keys (e.g., parking → parking_enforcement)
key_functions.getBobContext: Derive Bob context from active module + shift data

gps_tracking.purpose: Officer location for dispatch, live map, man-down detection

module_gating_logic.configured: Flag whether org has been configured with module rows
module_gating_logic.filtered_access: if (configured) grantedModules.filter(m => orgModules.has(canonicalModuleKey(m))); else grantedModules (fail-open during rollout)

render_flow.state_2_home: OfficerHome: active/upcoming shift, offered shifts, module selector, quick actions
render_flow.state_3_selector: ModuleSelector: grid of enabled modules if officer has multiple
render_flow.state_4_portal: ModulePortal: specific module with back button, header, content, Report FAB

supabase_integration.active_shift_load: useActiveShift hook queries shifts, patrol_routes, user_profiles, location_id
supabase_integration.offered_shifts_count: Count shifts with status='published' for pending banner
supabase_integration.gps_tracking: Write officer_gps_log on heartbeat; read for man-down inactivity detection
supabase_integration.error_handling: Fail-open: if module config unavailable, show all granted modules

DispatchConsolePage.tsx.purpose: Real-time dispatch console for creating and managing field jobs

architecture.three_columns: Shifts (left) | Stops (center) | Jobs (right); becomes tabs on mobile (issue #17)
architecture.dispatch_workflow: Select shift → View stops → Create job → Assign resource → Resolve billing rate

job_phases.phase_a: Load active shifts, recent jobs, client sites, dispatch resources
job_phases.phase_b: Load shift stops when shift selected
job_phases.phase_c: Load requester orgs for selected site (geofence + agreement filtering)
job_phases.phase_d: Resolve billing rate based on job type + requester + site + zone

architecture.role_access: grand_master, master, admin can create jobs; all can view

ActiveShift.officerLastSeen: ISO timestamp of last GPS fix

ResourceUnit.name: resource name
ResourceUnit.gpsLat: assigned officer GPS lat or null
ResourceUnit.gpsLng: assigned officer GPS lng or null

state_management.selectedShiftId: Currently selected shift for stop inspection
state_management.shiftStops: Array of stops for selected shift

phase_d_state.isUnrateable: Job cannot be rated (no rule match)

supabase_queries.phase_a_active_shifts: SELECT shifts with joins to user_profiles, patrol_routes; filter by org_id, status IN (published, accepted, in_progress); order by scheduled_start
supabase_queries.phase_a_recent_jobs: SELECT dispatch_jobs with joins to client_sites; filter by org_id; order by created_at DESC
supabase_queries.phase_a_officer_gps: SELECT officer_gps_log (latest per officer); used for nearest-unit recommendation
supabase_queries.phase_a_dispatch_resources: SELECT dispatch_resources; filter by org_id; join with latest officer GPS if assigned
supabase_queries.phase_b_shift_stops: SELECT shift_stops; filter by shift_id; order by sequence
supabase_queries.phase_c_requester_orgs: RPC call with PostGIS: union of (1) geofence-contained orgs, (2) existing operational agreements, (3) site owner org
supabase_queries.phase_d_billing_rules: SELECT rate_rules; filter by job_type, requester_org_id, zone_id

key_functions.loadData: Load active shifts, jobs, sites, resources (Phase A)
key_functions.loadShiftStops: Load stops for selected shift (Phase B)
key_functions.loadRequesterOrgs: Load eligible requester orgs for site (Phase C)
key_functions.resolveAgreement: Match requester + job type + site to operational agreement
key_functions.resolveBillingRate: Match job type + requester + zone to rate rule
key_functions.calculateSLAImpact: Compute warning if job creation after SLA window

dispatch_workflow.step_1_shift_selection: Click shift card; load stops (Phase B)
dispatch_workflow.step_2_stop_inspection: View shift stops, ETA, completion status, patrol route map
dispatch_workflow.step_3_site_selection: Choose client site or create new site inline
dispatch_workflow.step_4_job_creation: Fill form: job type, priority, SLA minutes, briefing notes
dispatch_workflow.step_5_requester_resolution: Phase C: geofence + agreement filtering to requester org
dispatch_workflow.step_6_zone_selection: Map site to billing zone for rate rule matching (Phase D)
dispatch_workflow.step_7_rate_resolution: Match rate rule based on job type + requester + zone
dispatch_workflow.step_8_resource_assignment: Assign to available resource / callsign or leave unassigned

mobile_responsive.layout: Three-column becomes tab bar on mobile (issue #17)
mobile_responsive.interaction: Selecting shift auto-jumps to Stops tab
mobile_responsive.reasoning: Dispatcher works one shift at a time on phone; columns unreadable

error_handling.load_errors: Display in top error banner; user can dismiss
error_handling.sla_breach_warning: Display if job created after SLA window expires
error_handling.unrateable_job: Warn if job type + requester + zone has no matching rate rule

AdminHubPage.tsx.purpose: Admin dashboard with KPI widgets, trend chart, module cards, NOC terminal

dashboard_sections: KPI grid (4 tiles: scans, breaches, patrols, welfare alerts)
Sticky priority-action bar (links to key pages)
Module cards grid (14 cards linking to field modules)

KpiData.patrols: integer count active shifts (published, accepted, scheduled, in_progress)

TrendDay.scans: integer count observations on that day
TrendDay.breaches: integer count breach_alerts on that day

supabase_queries.trend_data: supabase.from('observations').select('id, created_at').eq('organization_id', orgId).gte('created_at', trendStart); supabase.from('breach_alerts').select('id, created_at').eq('organization_id', orgId).gte('created_at', trendStart); bucket by date; build max/min per day

key_functions.loadKpi: Fetch all 4 KPI counts in parallel (Promise.all)
key_functions.loadTrend: Fetch observations + breach_alerts for date range; bucket by day
key_functions.onNavigate: Navigation callback passed to child components (StickyBar, HubCard)

kpi_tile_structure.label: Display text (Scans, Breaches, Patrols, Welfare Alerts)
kpi_tile_structure.colour: Alert status colour (green for ok, red for alerts)

sticky_priority_bar.sticky: Remains visible at top during scroll; z-index 10

trend_chart.display: Stacked bar chart with scan (blue) + breach (red) overlaid
trend_chart.interaction: Hover shows date, scan count, breach count

module_cards.grid: auto-fill minmax(200px, 1fr) on desktop; 2 columns on mobile

noc_terminal.display: Terminal-themed card with red accent border
noc_terminal.note: Hard-coded placeholder values; actual telemetry implementation pending

page_props.onNavigate: Callback (page: AdminPage) => void for child StickyBar and HubCard clicks

responsive_behavior.desktop: 4-column KPI grid, sticky bar horizontal, 14-card module grid
responsive_behavior.mobile: 2-column KPI grid (compact variant), sticky bar wrapped, 2-column card grid

WelfareAlertsPage.tsx.purpose: Welfare alerts dashboard: officer check-ins, missed check-ins, SOS alerts, man-down escalation

architecture.escalation_model: Server-authoritative; client-side detection but server owns escalation path

welfare_alerts_table.resolved_by: user UUID of admin who resolved
welfare_alerts_table.acknowledged_by: user UUID of admin who acknowledged
welfare_alerts_table.gps_lat: officer GPS lat at alert time or null
welfare_alerts_table.gps_lng: officer GPS lng at alert time or null
welfare_alerts_table.metadata: JSON extra data (last seen time, inactivity duration, etc.)

key_functions.query_alerts: Load open/acknowledged welfare_alerts ordered by escalation_level DESC, created_at DESC
key_functions.resolve: PATCH welfare_alerts SET status='resolved', resolved_at=now(), resolved_by=current_user_id
key_functions.auto_resolve_on_movement: If officer GPS moves significantly after man_down alert, server-side auto-resolve

supabase_realtime.subscription: postgres_changes on welfare_alerts table; listen for INSERT, UPDATE
supabase_realtime.on_new_alert: Add to alert list, flag severity, trigger notification
supabase_realtime.on_acknowledged: Remove from open list, mark as acknowledged in UI

uses: AdminHubPage: KPI count of welfareAlerts (open status)
DispatchConsolePage: Welfare alert display for dispatch oversight
OfficerShell: Welfare status colour on FieldSafetyBar
LiveMapPage: Officer pin colour-coded by welfare status
WelfareAlertsPage: Admin dashboard for alert triage

extraction_quality.WelfareAlertsPage.tsx: Partial (referenced in search results; full read TBD)

key_architectural_insights.shell_pattern: Both admin and officer portals use state machines (page/module selection) with URL sync and legacy redirect support
key_architectural_insights.module_gating: Two-level: user role + org-level module enablement; fail-open during rollout but hardening needed for safety-critical modules
key_architectural_insights.supabase_integration: Heavy use of real-time subscriptions for shifts, welfare alerts, GPS tracking; parallel queries for dashboard KPIs
key_architectural_insights.lazy_loading: React.lazy() for code-splitting on admin container pages; Suspense boundaries inside shell main content
key_architectural_insights.bob_integration: Bob context derived from active page/module; navigation-aware AI assistant in both admin and officer portals
key_architectural_insights.safety_signals: Welfare status (ok/due/overdue/man_down/sos) propagated across live-map, dispatch console, officer shell FieldSafetyBar

known_limitations.WelfareAlertsPage: Only 360 lines; full read not yet transcribed (partial search results available)
known_limitations.DispatchConsolePage: 1568 lines; full read would require additional message extraction windows (major sections covered)
known_limitations.styling: CSS-in-JS style objects extracted but not fully analyzed (focus on component architecture and data flow)
